item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 26/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to Guangdong in the next couple of days. With a strong easterly airstream reaching the coast of Guangdong midweek this week, the trough of low pressure is expected to move southwards slightly, and bring unsettled weather to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Ewiniar will move across the seas east of Luzon in the next couple of days, it will then move towards the western North Pacific to the south of Japan.
